properties.name: reflow2 keeps the link between a design and wherever it is being implemented, in both directions
properties.statement: The design records each implementation of it — which repository or storage, which branch, which part of the design it realizes — and where each of its artifacts is kept, so an agent starting from the design finds the implementation and an agent working in the code finds its design. Where a checkout sits on a particular machine stays in that machine's configuration, never in the design. From Anthony, 2026-09-25: "the design object still needs to know if and where is anything that is being implemented ... the linkage between design and implementation must be maintained by reflow2."
